name: log10
comment: Sig: r = log10(...). Element-wise libm-backed primitive (SIMD via Highway hn::Log10). Negative scalar promotes to complex: log10(-1)==0+1.364i. ARRAY promotion (fixed 2026-06-05): any negative element promotes the WHOLE array — log10([-100 100])=[2+1.36438i 2+0i] (previously the negative became real NaN). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b.
